hints.title: Undirected Graph Conversion
hints.text: Convert the directed tree hierarchy into an undirected graph by noting parent links.

hints.title: Parent Map Construction
hints.text: Map each node to its parent pointer through an initial traversal of the tree.

hints.title: Radius Expansion Traversal
hints.text: Traverse outward from the target node across left child, right child, and parent edges until reaching distance k.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in tree
complexity.notes: Parent mapping followed by bounded radial traversal visiting every node at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Tree child pointers alone cannot navigate upward toward ancestors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Parent reference table and visited set require O(N) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Augment the tree with bidirectional parent pointers or track ancestor distances during DFS.
